main_text.l: Afran. Suffocat me aliquid. Conflictari molestiis. Hæc me refricant, Cic. Vid. Solicitum esse.
Angiportus, & um) Limes, Liv. Extra latos vicos urbis, semita transversa, Bud. Laura, Suid.
Angiportus impervius] Angiportum non pervium, Ter. Fundulæ, Varro (à fundo quia exitum habent, Turneb.)
Angina] Angor faucium hominis, Plin. Synanche, es, Cels. (proprie suum angor.)
Angularis] In flexu viæ sita domus. In flexu vici eminens. Angularius, Procul. IC.
(2) Externe] Angulus intimus, Ovid. Lateris angulus, qui ad orientem spectat, Cic.
Angustia] Angustitas, Accibec. Non. Angusta viarum, Virgil. Via angusta ædium, urbis. Coarctatio, Liv. Contractura columnarum, Vitruv.

Angustare] Coarctare, Liv. Coangustare, Var. In angustum claudere, concludere, deducere, Cic. In angustum cogere, Ter. In angustias compellere, Coarctare, Cic. Introrsus agere, Sen. Coactare, Lucr. Coërcere, Cic. Addensere, Virg.

Angustari] Arctè accubare, Plaut. Urgeri angustiis, Cic. Inter cuneos mihi accubare videor, Plaut. In puteo constringi. In angusto esse. In angustum includi. Constipari in locum unum tantus numerus nequit, Cic.
Angustus] Arctum theatrum, Hor. Arctus annulus, Amm. Per angustum fretum, Cic. Præten uis pons. Contractus, Col. Confer Arctus.
Anguis] Serpens, Plin. Python, Ovid. Coluber, Virg.
Anguinus] Anguineus, Cic. Anguigena,& Serpentigena, Ovid.

Anhelare propr.] Boves anhelant, Ovid. Crebras auras reducere, Lucr. Vix sufferre anhelitum, Plaut. Vehementer & crebrò spirare, morbi testimonium, Cels. Ducit anhelitum ex cursurâ, Plaut. Ilia ducere, Plaut. Ilia trahere
